proposals.title: Customer-Specific Fixed Euro Price List
proposals.executiveSummary: Add a first version of customer-specific Euro pricing so an eligible customer can be quoted and invoiced using fixed EUR material prices instead of prices converted from GBP at the configured exchange rate.
proposals.problem: TidyStock requires material pricing levels to use the business's GBP base currency and converts those prices into EUR. proposals.scope: First version: allow an authorised user to create and maintain one customer-specific material price list denominated in EUR; apply its fixed EUR prices when that customer is selected for a sale; retain existing GBP-based conversion when no applicable fixed EUR price exists; and clearly identify the applied pricing source during sales entry. Non-goals: supporting additional non-base currencies, redesigning general pricing levels, automating exchange-rate management, bulk price import, retrospective repricing, or changing accounting and invoicing behaviour beyond selecting the applicable fixed EUR price.

proposals.estimateAssumptions: This independent scenario assumes approval and one developer's capacity are available from 2026-07-27; it is not a promise or portfolio schedule.
